Permitted variation around a quality criterion, where one has been agreed.
The user and business interests approve criteria through the project’s agreed authority.
Quality assurance reviews quality arrangements independently; project assurance checks the project for the board.
The first records checks and their results; the second tracks product status and approval.

q: Maya wants smooth gameplay on phones. What should Zosia do with this expectation?
a: Turn the user quality expectation into measurable acceptance criteria. A general expectation needs testable criteria.

q: Kamil runs unit tests and measures frames per second. Which activity is this?
a: Quality control. Quality control checks a specific product against its criteria.

q: An independent auditor checks whether the agreed test approach is followed. Which activity is this?
a: Quality assurance. Quality assurance assesses whether the quality system and methods are appropriate and followed.

q: Which management product sets project wide testing standards, methods and responsibilities?
a: Quality management approach. It defines how quality will be planned, controlled and assured.

q: Where are planned and completed quality checks and their results recorded?
a: Quality register. The quality register tracks quality control activities and outcomes.

q: How does a project product description differ from an individual product description?
a: The first describes the whole project product and its acceptance; the second describes a particular product. Their scope and purpose differ.

q: What is the key difference between quality control and quality assurance?
a: Control checks products; assurance independently assesses the quality approach. They operate at different levels.

q: A description of criteria and methods for one product is a product [...].
a: Description. A product description states the quality criteria and the quality methods for a product.

q: Which TWO management products support the quality practice?
a: Quality management approach; Quality register. The approach defines the method; the register records planned and completed checks.

q: Which statement about quality assurance is FALSE?
a: It consists of writing unit tests for the application. Unit tests are a form of quality control.

q: Planned and completed quality reviews and results are recorded in the quality [...].
a: Register. The quality register is the record of quality control activities.
